response.sql: WITH lab_ratios AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, l.WBC, CASE WHEN l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT <> 0 THEN l.HGB / l.HCT ELSE NULL END as hgb_hct_ratio FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID), patient_aggregates AS (SELECT ID, SEX, AVG(WBC) as avg_wbc, AVG(hgb_hct_ratio) as avg_ratio FROM lab_ratios GROUP BY ID, SEX), overall_statistics AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratio FROM patient_aggregates WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL), final_results AS (SELECT pa.ID, pa.SEX, pa.avg_wbc, pa.avg_ratio, pa.avg_ratio - os.mean_ratio as ratio_minus_mean FROM patient_aggregates pa CROSS JOIN overall_statistics os WHERE pa.avg_ratio > os.mean_ratio) SELECT ID, SEX, avg_wbc, avg_ratio, ratio_minus_mean FROM final_results ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio_minus_mean IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio_minus_mean DESC LIMIT 10
